g.text: FIT · PERFORMANCE ENHANCEMENT · PART 5.2 — COST · CLOSE OF ARC 5.0 › 5.1 › 5.2 · CAPSTONE OF THE 15-ARTICLE TRACK
INSTRUMENT № PE-5.2 · PROVISIONING DEPOT / BURN-RATE METERING LEDGER
BUDGET THE BURN RATE, NOT THE RECEIPT
cost is not an affordability problem — it's an uncertainty problem. plan the year, meter the monthly burn, and the gear turns out to be the cheap part. food is the bill.
AXIS = MONEY / UNITS (not time — time is only the run-out flags)
GREEN = MONEY THAT ACTUALLY FLOWS EACH MONTH
RED = THE ONE GO / NO-GO: THE FOOD-READINESS GATE
TWO DOCUMENTS KILL THE PANIC · A BUDGETING PLAN + A STOCK PLAN · THEN SPENDING IS PREDICTABLE, NOT SCARY
① PLAN THE CYCLE, LIST EVERY VARIABLE
② PREDICT THE STOCK, THEN THE COST · ③ HOLD A STOCK PLAN TO YEAR-END
④ BUDGET THE PART THAT ACTUALLY COSTS MORE
YOU CAN'T BUDGET WHAT YOU HAVEN'T PLANNED
← from 3.2 cycle design ← from 5.1 year map
Test base · maybe EQ · the occasional oral
SITUATIONAL — TUDCA/NAC on orals · P5P with
19-nors · T4 with GH · glucose agent with GH
FOLD-OUT CONTINGENCY TABS IF X → +RM Y
name the variables that move the bill
BEFORE they move it — then a dose hike or
a hot month is a known cost, not a panic.
▣ BUDGETING PLAN — what leaves the account
▣ STOCK PLAN — what to buy, in what bulk,
and when each item runs out.
together they turn a scary receipt into a drip.
fill height = the bulk CART you bought once · spout width = the true MONTHLY BURN · flag = run-out date
a RM100 box that lasts 600 days is RM5 / MONTH — not RM100
↑ tall tank = big one-time cart | thin spout = cheap per month — the protective core is exactly this shape
prep once, then re-buy ONLY the fast movers.
halves the spout, DOUBLES the run-out.
AND stretches the box — often the single
monthly burn converges into the ledger →
the myth-buster — the receipt is paid once; the meter is the bill
THE RECEIPT IS PAID ONCE. THE METER IS THE BILL.
bars sized by what actually LEAVES your account each month · STEP ④
PHARMA CORE — ARB·statin·aspirin·tadalafil = the thinnest trickle
FOOD ≫ GYM + CONSUMABLES > BLOODWORK > PHARMA CORE
people brace for the gear to bankrupt them; in a moderate, longevity-
minded protocol it's the cheapest recurring line.
THE FOOD-READINESS INTERLOCK — the one go/no-go
IF THE FOOD BUDGET SCARES YOU, YOU'RE NOT READY FOR THE GEAR.
an under-fed cycle wastes the (cheap) drugs anyway. feeding the
physique is the prerequisite, not an afterthought.
red appears nowhere else → the readiness signal of Part 1.
THE TRACK CLOSES HERE — 15 ARTICLES, ONE SPINE
the final node lights up; the point was never a protocol to copy — it's the reasoning to run your own
STOCKING ORDER — invert the common mistake
BUY: ① SHIELD → ② GEAR → ③ MONITORING / CONSUMABLES
SPLIT THE SPLITTABLE — lowers the dose AND doubles the box · the pharmaceutical core costs less per month than two restaurant dinners.
measured, intact, and affordable enough to sustain for YEARS — that was always the point.

Budgeting & planning only — NOT sourcing, vendors, or acquisition. All ringgit figures (RM5 / RM35 / RM60–80 / RM500–600) are illustrative reference points to demonstrate the burn-rate METHOD, not a price list.
Compounds referenced are prescription-only / illegal without a prescription in most jurisdictions including Malaysia. Nothing here is medical or financial advice.
IF YOU'RE SO SMART, WHY ARE YOU NOT — FIT · PERFORMANCE ENHANCEMENT
